notes.title: Dimensions Definitive Edition 1.1.2 is Here!
notes.notes:
Introducing Dimensions Definitive Edition 1.1.2!
Get ready to dive into the ultimate gaming experience with Dimensions Definitive Edition 1.1.2! This update is packed with exciting features and improvements that will take your gameplay to the next level.

Highlights of Version 1.1.2:

File Size: The game now takes up only 9GB, ensuring a smooth and seamless download process.

Steam Deck Optimization: Enjoy a flawless gaming experience on your Steam Deck with enhanced performance and controls.

APU Compatibility: Play effortlessly on systems with Ryzen APUs starting from the 3200G.

Content Expansion: Discover new levels, quests, and characters with our expanded content that will keep you engaged for hours.

New Menu: Navigate the game with ease using our completely redesigned and intuitive menu system.

New Animations: Experience more lifelike and dynamic animations that bring the game world to life.

Complete Overhaul: The game has been rebuilt from the ground up, providing a fresh and revitalized experience for both new and returning players.

Free Update: All players will receive the Dimensions Definitive Edition for free, making it accessible to everyone.

Join us in celebrating this monumental update and explore the new Dimensions like never before. Thank you for your continued support, and we can’t wait to see you in the game!

For some time a group of people have been dedicated to defaming the game and to date they continue to make bad faith reviews such as that the game does not run a 3060 when it is made to work with integrated graphics, the dialogues that in Spanish are bad when it does not even have dialogues in Spanish and has a high quality English dubbing subtitled.

[h3]THE ANSWER AGAINST THE HATERS[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44618371/de24b02b632592b21e63f632d19a493007cd8185.png[/img]

That's why for today alone the game will be at 95% off so you can see for yourself that the game was really made with love and by a single person it was months and months of work so I appreciate you taking the time to play this new improved version.

This offer will only be available today.

notes.title: 🎉 Dimensions Update 5.0 Release! 🎉
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce the arrival of Dimensions Update 5.0! This new version completely revamps the game’s story, offering a more intense and frenetic experience. Here’s a glimpse of what you can expect:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44618371/255ee899a2fdd749fda50b2691b313992929b3e5.jpg[/img]

🌟 Combined 2D and 3D Levels: Now, 2D and 3D levels blend seamlessly, creating a unique and exciting gameplay dynamic.

📖 Enhanced Narrative: We’ve worked hard to improve the game’s narrative, making the story more immersive and captivating.

🎮 Optimized Gameplay: Enjoy smoother and improved gameplay with new mechanics and challenges that will test your skills.

Don’t miss out on this incredible update! Download Dimensions Update 5.0 and dive into a renewed, action-packed adventure.

notes.title: Dimensions Official Release
notes.notes:
[h1]Play Now Dimensions On Steam[/h1]

Thanks to everyone who joined me during Early Access, today Dimensions goes to Official Release and I will continue to add content as well as new endings to the game.

[h1]What's next?[/h1]

The Dimensions you knew from Early Access no longer exists, that was the green part, Dimensions 4.1.2 is already here and with a frenetic story about travel in the multiverse and a cyberpunk genre story based on the 2014 Dimensions comic book that I removed to avoid spoilers.
